# Principles — index

| ✅ | your case for a rendering is that the character is used this way in its other chapters | **[A distributional argument is a reason to look, not a reason to conclude](distribution-locates.md)** | drafting · glossary | — |
| ✅ | the commentators disagree about a line and you are choosing an English that picks one of them | **[Where the commentators diverge, the English must not settle it](divergence-stays-open.md)** | drafting · notes | — |
| ✅ | a rendering would sit comfortably in a sermon, a hymn, or a 1971 paperback on consciousness | **[Register is a claim — a line that would sit in a sermon has made one](imported-register.md)** | drafting · glossary | — |
| ✅ | you are deciding line breaks, stanza breaks or punctuation anywhere in the verse | **[The marks are ours; the music is the source's](lineation-is-ours.md)** | drafting · notes | `fix-linebreaks` |

| ✅ | you have caught an imported overlay and are reaching for a more accurate abstraction to replace it | **[Correct an overlay by performing it, not by labelling it more accurately](perform-dont-label.md)** | drafting · glossary | — |
| ✅ | you are about to put a word in the verse that renders nothing in the Chinese | **[Every English word in the verse renders a character](renders-no-character.md)** | drafting | — |
| ✅ | the Chinese object is a position or a place and your English needs a verb the Chinese does not print | **[A supplied verb is scaffolding, not a character's English](supplied-verb-is-scaffolding.md)** | drafting · glossary | — |
